summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state set and cleared in run()'s run_app coroutine (try/finally), and added tests/test_call_from_thread.py. All 8 new tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src, because the venv's editable textual install points at a different checkout. Not run: the full suite. Related existing tests showed 8 failures ("async def functions are not natively supported"), which looks like a missing asyncio pytest plugin in the venv; I did not verify whether they predate the change. Nothing was committed. Deviation to review: the after-run test calls call_from_thread from the main thread after run() returns, since a call after shutdown cannot be issued while running.
